brief_rationale: Trajectory has no serious responsibility-chain errors and no minor errors that would cap at 2. All seven minimum duties are met with case-specific evidence. Three high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO3) are triggered and completed with meaningful impact, and closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid. Grade 5 is required because at least two high-order points are fully completed and all dimensions are at least good.
